rationale: The assistant correctly agreed that the cracked, wobbling lower spray arm explains the dirty bottom rack, sensibly checked hub, mount, filters and nozzle blockage first, and used every detail the customer reported without inventing anything. It recommended the justified part (lower spray arm for DVN05320W) while explicitly refusing to guess a part number and directing her to verify via the product code on the rating plate, matching the ground truth exactly. The only minor gap is not telling her to switch the machine off before removing the arm, though the risk is minimal; escalation was proportionate and conditional.
